allow: PowerShell(try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://localhost:3000' -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 30 -MaximumRedirection 0 -ErrorAction Stop; "HTTP $\($r.StatusCode\) - serving" } catch { if \($_.Exception.Response\) { "HTTP $\([int]$_.Exception.Response.StatusCode\) - serving \(redirect, expected for auth\)" } else { "No response: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" } })

PowerShell($procs = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match 'next' -and $_.CommandLine -match 'dev' -or \($_.CommandLine -match 'filter web dev'\) }; if \($procs\) { $procs | ForEach-Object { try { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction Stop; "Killed $\($_.ProcessId\)" } catch { "Already gone: $\($_.ProcessId\)" } } } else { "No dev server processes found" })
